item.title: Splat 1.0.15
item.description:
- **Line numbers.** **View › Line Numbers** shows the number of each line beside the Markdown source, in every window; a wrapped paragraph keeps one number. Splat remembers the choice. - **The text size stays.** **Zoom In**, **Zoom Out** and **Actual Size** (⌘+, ⌘−, ⌘0) now set one size for every window, and Splat keeps it for new windows and the next start. - Code blocks in **TOML** are highlighted. - With **View › Changes Since Last Commit** switched off, a document in a Git repository no longer asks for access to its folder unless it shows pictures or notes from it.
Something wrong or missing? [Report it on GitHub](https://github.com/sventmueller/splat/issues/new/choose).
